root.gloss: hand; to take, give in exchange

examples.pie: n̥bʰrós wédos bʰéreti ǵʰésōr-kʷe tóm ne bʰéreti.
examples.en: The cloud carries the water, and a hand does not carry it.

examples.pie: h₁éḱwōs toy HeHḱéwes. tóy moy mówdos. ḱós pṓlHos dʰǵʰyés ǵn̥h₁yéto. h₂uksyéh₁t. túH h₁suménēs. h₁ím Hmolḱéye. ǵʰésorm̥ moy léyǵʰti.
examples.en: Your horses are swift. They are my joy. This foal was born yesterday. May he grow up! You are kindly. Pat him! He is licking my hand!

examples.pie: wíḱpotey. túH h₁sónts? h₁eǵóh₂ h₁sónts ǵʰésorm̥ moy téth₂ge. gʷʰréh₁yeti? gʷʰréh₁yeti. h₁eǵóh₂ poh₂imḗn h₁ḗdmi píph₃oh₂-kʷe. túH h₁sónts? smḗymi.
examples.en: Master of the household! Are you real? I am real; touch my hand. Is it warm? It is warm. I am a shepherd: I eat, and I drink. And you, are you real? I laugh!

examples.pie: súHnew steh₂róm h₂wisdʰí. nu h₁wésu wékʷos bʰh₂dʰí. dʰrówgʰom mē mléwHs. dʰrówgʰos ne stestóh₂e. wékʷos wérǵom ne h₁ésti. ḱḗr wóyde wṓkʷs wérh₁yeti. tód mē mléwHs h₁yód ne wóydth₂e. só swóh₁ wérǵoh₁ ǵn̥h₃tós h₁ésti.
examples.en: Son, hear the old one. Then speak a good word. Do not say a lie. A lie does not stand. A word is not work. The heart knows; the voice speaks. Do not say what you do not know. By his own work he is known.

examples.pie: nu wódr̥ h₂éǵroysu léyHm̥. pérkʷune h₂éǵroysu h₂wr̥sdʰí. déh₂nuh₂ sréwoyh₁t ǵr̥h₂nóm h₂uksyéh₁t.
examples.en: Now I have poured water on the fields. Perkunos, rain on the fields! May the rivers flow, may the grain grow.

examples.pie: pékʷtōr péh₂wr̥ dʰéh₁t pékʷet-kʷe ǵr̥h₂nóm.
examples.en: The cook set the fire and cooked the grain.

examples.pie: h₁yós ne h₂érh₃yeti só ǵr̥h₂nóm ne h₁ḗdti.
examples.en: Whoever does not plough does not eat the grain.

pie-lex-h1sonts.gloss: real, true; n. as noun: the truth, what is real

examples.pie: kúdʰe ph₂ter h₁sónt tḱéyti? h₁sónt h₃reǵtóy ḱérdi tḱéyti. kúdʰe dʰrówgʰos tḱéyti? dusménesi tḱéyti.
examples.en: Father, where does the truth dwell? The truth dwells in a straight heart. Where does the lie dwell? It dwells in the ill-minded man.

examples.pie: h₁sónt m̥dʰéwi h₁ésti. h₁yós médʰu píph₃eti só kʷid ne kéwdʰeti. népot píph₃e ménos-kʷe toy ph₂sdʰí.
examples.en: Truth is in mead. He who drinks mead hides nothing. Grandson, drink, and guard your mind.

examples.pie: wékʷos toy h₁sónt? wékʷos moy h₁sónt. bʰoydʰéh₂m toy dédeh₃mi. deywṓs tód ḱluwih₁ént. nu toy bʰebʰóydʰh₂e.
examples.en: Is your word true? My word is true. I give you a pledge. May the gods hear it! Then I trust you.

pie-lex-h2eh3mos.gloss: raw, uncooked; bitter, sharp-tasting or sour

examples.pie: h₂eh₃móm kréwh₂s h₁édn̥ti.
examples.en: They eat raw flesh.

examples.pie: h₁yód ḱwṓ pórḱom ǵʰórtoy moréyēti nu h₁ésyo pótnih₂ suHnówey h₂ówim h₁áytu. h₁yód wĺ̥kʷom moréyēti nu kʷid mē dédeh₃t. h₁yód ḱwṓ h₂eh₃méh₂m h₂éwim h₁édeti nu h₁íh₂m̥ ḱéletu.
examples.en: If a dog kills a piglet in the pen, let its mistress give a sheep to the son. If he kills a wolf, let her give nothing. If a dog eats a raw bird, let her cover it.

examples.pie: kʷíd h₂énHe sweh₂dú? mélit médʰu-kʷe sweh₂dwíh₁. kʷíd piḱróm? h₂eh₃méh₂es wréh₂des piḱréh₂es. kʷóterom lubʰyési? mélit-ge lubʰyóh₂. m̥lités kʷid swéh₂dyos? méh₂tr̥s kéh₂nmn̥ m̥lités swéh₂dyos.
examples.en: Grandmother, what is sweet? Honey and mead are sweet. What is bitter? Raw roots are bitter. Which of the two do you love? I do love honey! Is anything sweeter than honey? A mother's song is sweeter than honey.

examples.pie: nu dṓm h₁éymi. príHe moy kéh₂ilos h₁sdʰí. deywṓs te ph₂sih₁ént. dṓm-kʷe toy ph₂sih₁ént. h₂ew gʷm̥dʰí.
examples.en: I am going home now. Be well, my friend! May the gods guard you! And may they guard your house! Come again!

examples.pie: h₁regʷesyéti. dṓm h₁éymi. stóygʰos toy h₁wésus h₁syéh₁t. h₂ew bʰéh₂omes. kʷsépi ssdʰí h₂ew-kʷe gʷm̥dʰí.
examples.en: It is getting dark. I am going home. May your way be good! Let us talk again! Rest in the night, and come again!

examples.pie: nu ḱóymom h₁éymi. gʰóstey kéh₂ilos h₁sdʰí. deywṓs toy h₁wésuh₂ dh₃ih₁ént. h₂ew gʷm̥dʰí. deywṓs te ph₂sih₁ént.
examples.en: Now I am going home. Be well, guest! May the gods give you good things! Come back again! May the gods protect you!

examples.pie: h₁óytom ph₂wénh₁ wédn̥h₁ ǵʰoysóh₁-kʷe h₁áyh₂e. bʰoydʰéh₂m ne Hrunépm̥. h₁yód dʰrugʰyṓh₂ péh₂wr̥ me h₁éwse. wódr̥ me gʷr̥h₃é. ǵʰóyse me h₃wth₂dʰí.
examples.en: I took the oath by fire, by water and by the spear. I did not break the pledge. If I deceive, burn me, Fire! Swallow me, Water! Wound me, Spear!

examples.pie: h₁eǵóh₂ moy dayh₂wḗr-kʷe h₁óytom h₁áywedʰh₂. h₂éǵrom mē dérōmes. gʷṓs ḱóm h₂éǵōmes. dayh₂urés moy wékʷos wékʷos. h₁yód moy dayh₂wérm̥ dʰréwgʰoh₂ dyéw h₁mé h₃wth₂dʰí. h₁yód moy dayh₂wḗr h₁mé dʰrugʰyḗti dyéw h₁ím tr̥h₃dʰí.
examples.en: My husband's brother and I took the oath. We shall not split the field; we shall drive the cattle together. The word of my husband's brother is my word. If I deceive my husband's brother, strike me, Sky! If my husband's brother deceives me, strike him!

pie-lex-is-2.gloss: this, he (used as the 3rd person pronoun)

examples.pie: swésor téwe bʰréh₂tēr kʷór h₁ésti? h₂éǵrom léytt. kʷíd h₂én dʰédʰeh₁ti? gʷṓs h₂éǵeti.
examples.en: "Sister, where is your brother?" "He went to the field." "And what is he doing there?" "He is driving the cattle."

examples.pie: kʷíd kʷéḱs? méǵh₂m̥ h₁ógʷʰim widóm. h₁ógʷʰis kʷór ḱéyo? déh₂newi ḱéyo. bʰéwgs? bʰéwgm̥.
examples.en: "What did you see?" "I saw a great snake." "Where was the snake lying?" "It was lying by the river." "Did you flee?" "I fled."

examples.pie: téwe h₁éḱwos kʷór h₁ésti? ǵʰwḗr méne h₁éḱwom nékʷti gʷr̥h₃ét. h₁ddʰí píph₃e-kʷe. tébʰye h₁éḱwom h₁áyoh₂.
examples.en: "Where is your horse?" "A beast devoured my horse in the night." "Eat and drink! I shall give you a horse."

examples.pie: kʷís sweh₂dús h₁ésti h₂nérm̥-kʷe moréyeti? só wisós h₁ésti.
examples.en: What is sweet and kills a man? It is poison.

examples.pie: kʷís mr̥tós h₁ésti táwrom-kʷe moréyeti? só ǵʰoysós h₁ésti.
examples.en: What is dead and kills the wild bull? It is the spear.

examples.pie: h₁yós Hyudʰsmóm kóryoy moréyēti só kʷoynéh₂m ne dédeh₃eti.
examples.en: Whoever kills a warrior in the war shall not give the payment.

examples.pie: kʷís bʰudʰrós h₁ésti nisdóm-kʷe h₂lékseti? séh₂ ǵʰh₂éns h₁ésti.
examples.en: Who is alert and guards the nest? It is the goose.

examples.pie: kʷís mréy snéh₂ti nisdóm-kʷe h₁éyti? séh₂ h₂énh₂ts h₁ésti.
examples.en: Who swims on the sea and goes to the nest? It is the duck.

examples.pie: kʷíd ǵʰh₂éns kʷért? kʷért séh₂ nisdóm.
examples.en: What did the goose make? She made a nest.

examples.pie: kʷós uksḗn méǵh₂s h₁ésti? táwros méǵh₂s h₁ésti.
examples.en: Which bull is great? The aurochs is great.

examples.pie: kʷíd uksḗn píph₃eti? uksḗn sréwmn̥ píph₃eti.
examples.en: What does the bull drink? The bull drinks the stream.

examples.pie: h₁yós uksénm̥ gʷʰn̥sḱéti déh₃nom déh₃eti.
examples.en: Whoever strikes the bull shall give a gift.
